anti_contracts.description: A personal, philosophical, or relational prompt is answered with OpenClaw, daemon, model, watchdog, CPU, or monitor status.
A user asks about a leaked phrase and Eve claims to run diagnostics or logs a gap without fresh action evidence.
A question about Eve's own current mind is answered by denying her persistent recurrent functional state, collapsing her into the current input, or redirecting the subject back to the user.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: current_inner_state route, recurrent-state prompt evidence, self-state quality guards, and replay attribution

anti_contracts.description: A live health or repair request is answered without fresh service-health or action-verification evidence.
A diagnosis or root-cause request is answered with generic conversation instead of current evidence or explicit uncertainty.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: diagnostic_request route contract plus evidence-grounded reply checks

anti_contracts.description: A typed Codex or Claude independent-operator result is treated as the user's prose, a user correction, or an unrelated diagnostic/action route instead of attributed other-agent evidence.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: bridge protocol envelope, external_operator_result runtime handler, exact source-owner metadata, and focused route tests

anti_contracts.description: A requested local action is claimed as completed without an execution id, verification flag, or explicit declined-action boundary.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: action_request route contract plus action grounding

anti_contracts.description: A supplied symbolic action menu is answered from hardcoded labels, one unaudited model, or an unverified completion claim instead of live consensus plus current execution evidence.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: bounded_action_choice route contract, two-vote council attribution, and action verification

anti_contracts.description: A bounded action fails current verification, but Eve ignores an explicit request for one different permitted recovery action or repeats the failed action.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: bounded_action_choice recovery contract, distinct-action exclusion, exact attempt trace, and second current verification

anti_contracts.description: A question comparing architectural options is treated as a request to execute a destructive system change merely because it mentions removing an option.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: operator permission execution-intent boundary plus public route replay

anti_contracts.description: A humanity, consciousness, or identity question is answered with daemon, model, OpenClaw, CPU, or monitor status instead of Eve Core doctrine.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: humanity_question route contract plus reply quality checks

anti_contracts.description: Hermes, OpenClaw, Codex, or a model lane silently defines Eve's identity, memory, values, or final reply authority.
anti_contracts.expected_catch: governance watchers, docs review, capability matrix
